trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read of the proposition. Recomputed both limits from hbar_q = 1 - q^{-1}: as q -> 1, hbar_q -> 0 so the commutator -> 0; as q -> infinity, q^{-1} -> 0 so hbar_q -> 1 and the commutator -> J. Both stated limits are correct. Two numbered items, not a triple; no negation-contrast, pivot, dash, aphorism, meta-commentary, restatement, warmth, superlative, or non-speakable chain.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: Separate flag (not a trap): BARE J again ('[X,P]_q = J hbar_q(p)'). notation-collisions.md states 'We never write bare J' - J is reserved for the Jones polynomial J_K(q) and the Bessel families, always with an argument. Same defect as rem:generating-functions-solve-reeb-flow in this chapter, so it is a chapter-level notation issue rather than a one-off. Also: hbar_q is written with a point argument, hbar_q(p), while def:quantum-planck-constant gives hbar_q = 1 - q^{-1} as a function of q alone; if the local-q programme is intended, say q(p).
